android._comment_versionCode: Overwritten by .github/workflows/build-apk.yml with the CI run number, so the installed build number matches the apk-<n> release tag. components/UpdateBanner.tsx compares the two to decide whether a newer APK exists; leaving this at a static 1 would make every build look out of date.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Forge OS to use your location for attendance verification.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Forge OS to access your camera for 5S photo submissions and QR scanning.

eas._comment: Not a secret — this UUID is compiled into the APK and ships to every phone. Required by Notifications.getExpoPushTokenAsync() in lib/notifications.ts; without it that call throws 'No projectId found' in a standalone build, push_tokens stays permanently empty, and every notification the edge functions send goes nowhere.
